sources.title: Radiologiset tutkimus- ja toimenpidemäärät 2024 (open data, CC BY 4.0)
sources.publisher: STUK (Finnish Radiation and Nuclear Safety Authority)
sources.notes: Examination counts by THL procedure code and age band, national only — no regional split. Chest X-ray with radiologist report GD1AA = 674,757; thorax CT GD1AD = 35,058. Downloaded to raw/stuk_2024.xlsx; parsed by scripts/stuk_thorax.py.

sources.title: Radiologisten tutkimusten ja toimenpiteiden määrät vuonna 2024 (report)
sources.notes: 663,000 CT examinations in 2024, 115 per 1,000 inhabitants. Survey response rate 92%.

sources.title: Monitorering af forløbstider på kræftområdet — årsopgørelse for 2025
sources.notes: Lung cancer B26 within standard pathway time 2025: surgery 77% national (Sjælland 53%, Syddanmark 86%), drug 86%, radiotherapy 70% (Sjælland 49%, Syddanmark 85%). Standard times 44/41/45 days. 58% of lung cancer pathways have the cancer suspicion ruled out during workup.

sources.title: Dansk Lunge Cancer Register — Årsrapport 2024
sources.publisher: Dansk Lunge Cancer Gruppe / Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut
sources.notes: Regional 1/2/5-year survival, indicator tables 3.1.1–3.1.3. National 5-year 25.3% (2019 cohort), regions 23.3%–28.5%. Registry attributes Region Sjælland's historical deficit to late arrival at specialist workup.

sources.title: Lungcancer — Nationell kvalitetsrapport för 2024
sources.notes: Against an 80% target, 36% started drug treatment within 40 days and 10% started surgery or radiotherapy within 44 days. Hospital variation 8%–68%. Registry coverage 98%. Also publishes EGFR testing rate per hospital.

sources.title: Standardiserat vårdförlopp lungcancer — ledtider
sources.notes: Target 80% within 40 days to drug treatment, 44 days to surgery/radiotherapy. Pre-pathway design allows 1 day referral decision to arrival, 5 days to lung X-ray/CT, 1 day result to referrer — about 7 days to a chest imaging result.

sources.title: Pakkeforløp for 24 organspesifikke kreftformer (quality indicator)
sources.notes: Target 70% of pathways within standard time; not met by any regional health authority 2023–2025. Lung cancer 57% in 2024. CAUTION: national publication is currently suspended pending correction of a reporting error in NPR.

sources.title: Imaging Data Repository (Kuva-aineistojen tietovaranto)
sources.notes: National DICOM archive; radiology storable since 2018, CT explicitly in scope. Access requires certified class-A PACS/RIS, provider status and patient consent; research use goes through Findata. Not reachable by a hackathon prototype, and deliberately not used.

sources.title: Statistics Finland WFS — wellbeing services county boundaries 2025
sources.notes: Layer tilastointialueet:hyvinvointialue4500k_2025. Map geometry in this app is projected and Douglas-Peucker simplified by scripts/build_map.py; small islands dropped, so coastlines are approximate.

sources.title: Lung cancer registries in Denmark, Finland, Norway and Sweden: a comparison and proposal for harmonization
sources.notes: Table 2 stage: DK I 25.4%, NO I 26.4%, SE I 22.6%; FI only Local 6% / Non-local 47% / Unknown 47%. Explains why Acta 2025 'FI 17% stage I' cannot come from this paper. AstraZeneca-funded. Critical for stage-claim honesty.

sources.title: Trends in treatment of non-small cell lung cancer in Finland 2014–2019
sources.notes: Actual source of '17% stage I': among 28% of 4047 university-hospital NSCLC patients with recorded stage (n=1133): I 17%, II 12%, III 22%, IV 49%. Not national population stage share. MSD co-authors.

sources.title: The effect of direct access to CT scan in early lung cancer detection: an unblinded, cluster-randomised trial
sources.notes: Only RCT of GP direct chest LDCT. Aarhus, 331 LC patients. No significant effect on stage at diagnosis or diagnostic interval. Strongest disconfirming evidence for 'CT access will fix stage/survival'.

sources.title: Computed tomography referral guidelines adherence in Europe: insights from a seven-country audit
sources.notes: Primary-source sentence: 'In Finland, general practitioners cannot refer to CT'. Strong independent confirmation of referral-rule claim (also Estonia, Hungary).

sources.title: Pakkeforløp lungekreft — Filterfunksjon
sources.notes: CT thorax (or chest X-ray) without delay on clinical suspicion, even if prior chest X-ray normal. Primary-care filter equivalent.

sources.title: Pakkeforløb for lungekræft (January 2025)
sources.notes: GP/referring doctor should consider contrast CT thorax+upper abdomen for listed symptoms in >40 with tobacco history; suspicious imaging opens lung pathway.

sources.title: Diagnostisk pakkeforløb (updated December 2023)
sources.notes: Requires GP direct access to diagnostic CT-TAB among other tests for non-specific serious symptoms pathway.

sources.title: Estimates of lung and pancreatic cancer survival in Sweden with and without inclusion of death certificate initiated (DCI) cases
sources.notes: Including DCI lung cases lowered 1-year OS 45%→41% in two Swedish regions. Disconfirms naive Sweden–Finland survival gap magnitude.

sources.title: Lung Cancer in Finland 2019–2023 — diagnostics, care pathways and quality of care (FCR/FICAN quality registry pilot report)
sources.notes: Stage missing 47.7%; localized ~5% of all / ~11% of staged; ~27% curative-intent first treatment (FICAN English summary). Refutes 'Finland cannot measure anything' while confirming measurement is incomplete.

sources.title: Cancer quality registry project
sources.notes: Joint FCR–THL–FICAN feasibility work toward national cancer quality register; lung reports 2018–2022 and 2019–2023 already published.

sources.title: Prognostic consequences of implementing cancer patient pathways in Denmark: a comparative cohort study of symptomatic cancer patients in primary care
sources.notes: 3-year RS improved after Danish CPP implementation (lung among cancers with significant change). Authors warn lead-time/selection bias. Evaluates whole three-legged reform, not GP-CT alone.

sources.notes: Context, not used in the model. Do not convert delay into deaths avoided.
